title: Double charge
content: If an invoice was charged twice, the second charge is reversed within 5 business days of the report. The customer does not need to do anything: the reversal appears as a credit on the payment method used. If after 5 days there is no reversal, the customer can ask for the case number.

title: Invoice details
content: The name and address on invoices are changed in the customer area, under Billing details. Invoicing a company requires its legal name and VAT number. The change applies from the next invoice: invoices already issued are not reissued.

title: Error 500 at login
content: An error 500 at login means a problem on our servers, not in the customer's browser: clearing the cache does not help. Ongoing outages are published on the service status page. If the status page reports nothing, the ticket goes to second-level support with the time of the attempt.

title: Exporting data
content: Data is exported as CSV from Settings, Export. An export can take up to an hour for large archives; when it is ready an email arrives with the link, valid for 7 days.

title: Resetting the password
content: The password is reset from the Forgot password link on the login page. The recovery email arrives within a few minutes: if it does not, check the spam folder and that the address is the registered one. After three failed attempts the account is locked for 30 minutes.

title: Closing the account
content: The account is closed from Settings, Close account. The data can be recovered for 30 days, then it is permanently deleted. Active subscriptions must be cancelled before closing.
